snippet.title: Rleotha: Trial of Gods - New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Rleotha: Trial of Gods is a 2D Auto Battler / Roguelite. It is a game where you are given six legionnaires (characters)  that you can place on the field and all have their passives / abilities to help you pass your trial. After every couple battles you will earn passives points to enhance your legionnaires' stats and abilities and after each boss you can select one of three buffs to help your team. In trials you can collect resources with your miners and use those resources to upgrade your legionnaires. If you want to take a break there is a mini-game aswell.
